The previous best-known approximation is 2 − 1 / n 2-1/n by Aziz et al. [IJCAI 2017].

arxiv-2103-07381.title: An elementary proof for dynamical scaling for certain fractional non-homogeneous Poisson processes
arxiv-2103-07381.creator: Markus Kreer
arxiv-2103-07381.description: Abstract Dynamical scaling is an asymptotic property typical for the dynamics of first-order phase transitions in physical systems and related to self-similarity. Based on the integral-representation for the marginal probabilities of a fractional non-homogeneous Poisson process introduced by Leonenko et al. (2017) and generalising the standard fractional Poisson process, we prove the dynamical scaling under fairly mild conditions.

arxiv-2201-06840.description: Abstract . The Neretin group 𝒩 d , k \mathcal{N}_{d,k} is the totally disconnected locally compact group consisting of almost automorphisms of the tree 𝒯 d , k \mathcal{T}_{d,k} . arxiv-2302-08237.title: A Cloud-based Deep Learning Framework for Early Detection of Pushing at Crowded Event Entrances
arxiv-2302-08237.creator: AHMED ALIA 1,2,3, MOHAMMED MAREE 4, MOHCINE CHRAIBI 1, ANAS TOMA 5, AND ARMIN SEYFRIED 1,2
arxiv-2302-08237.description: Abstract Crowding at the entrances of large events may lead to critical and life-threatening situations, particularly when people start pushing each other to reach the event faster. Automatic and timely identification of pushing behavior would help organizers and security forces to intervene early and mitigate dangerous situations.

arxiv-2411-11214.title: DeforHMR: Vision Transformer with Deformable Cross-Attention for 3D Human Mesh Recovery
arxiv-2411-11214.creator: Jaewoo Heo Stanford University jeffheo@stanford.edu, George Hu Stanford University gehu@stanford.edu Zeyu Wang Stanford University wangzeyu@stanford.edu Serena Yeung-Levy Stanford University syyeung@stanford.edu
arxiv-2411-11214.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jaewoo Heo Stanford University jeffheo@stanford.edu, George Hu Stanford University gehu@stanford.edu Zeyu Wang Stanford University wangzeyu@stanford.edu Serena Yeung-Levy Stanford University syyeung@stanford.edu. Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) is an important yet challenging problem with applications across various domains including motion capture, augmented reality, and biomechanics. Accurately predicting human pose parameters from a single image remains a challenging 3D computer vision task. In this work, we introduce DeforHMR , a novel regression-based monocular HMR framework designed to enhance the prediction of human pose parameters using deformable attention transformers.

arxiv-2509-00359.title: Looking beyond lambda
arxiv-2509-00359.creator: Alexie Leauthaud, Adam Riess
arxiv-2509-00359.description: Abstract Widening cracks are appearing in the Λ \Lambda CDM model and it is becoming increasingly clear that the standard cosmological model struggles to describe the full expansion history of the Universe as revealed by the Cosmic Microwave Background, Baryon Acoustic Oscillation measurements, and locally calibrated Type Ia supernovae.

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become essential tools for learning on relational data, yet the performance of a single GNN is often limited by the heterogeneity present in real-world graphs. pmc-13148485.title: Hybrid photocatalytic-ozonation for wastewater remediation: mechanisms and synergistic effects
pmc-13148485.creator: M. S. Lawan, Mansour A. Balkhyour, Rajeev Kumar, M. A. Barakat
pmc-13148485.description: Hybrid photocatalytic ozonation (PC/O3) has emerged as one of the most powerful advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) for degrading highly recalcitrant organic contaminants in industrial wastewater. By integrating semiconductor photocatalysis with ozone-driven oxidation, PC/O3 systems unlock synergistic reaction pathways that significantly accelerate the production of hydroxyl radicals, suppress electron–hole recombination, and improve ozone utilization efficiency.

pmc-13342733.title: Evaluation of the efficacy of hybrid arch bar versus conventional arch bar in the management of facial fractures: A pilot study
pmc-13342733.creator: Subhajit Mitra, Nitesh Mishra, Flora Kalita, Nimish Agarwal, Akhilesh K. Singh
pmc-13342733.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction:Intermaxillary fixation (IMF) has been utilized to stabilize maxilla/mandibular fractures and orthognathic procedures. In the literature, many techniques for maxillomandibular fixation are reported, including the use of arch bars or bone screws. Except for using bone screws, all other treatments run the danger of damaging the lips and periodontal tissues, taking longer duration, and exposing the surgeon or assistant to different infections through glove punctures and subsequent wire prick wounds. A redesigned hybrid arch bar is being utilized to solve these issues.

pmc-13531104.title: Magnolol Potentiates Sorafenib-induced Apoptosis and Inhibits Metastatic Signaling in Renal Carcinoma
pmc-13531104.creator: CHE-CHENG CHANG, MAN-YUN HUNG, YUEH-SHAN WENG, CHIEH-MIN CHANG, FEI-TING HSU, YU-HSIANG CHEN, JIANN-HWA CHEN
pmc-13531104.description: Background/AimSorafenib is a standard targeted therapy for renal cell carcinoma; however, resistance and limited efficacy remain clinical challenges. Magnolol, a bioactive compound derived from Magnolia officinalis, exhibits anti-cancer properties, and may enhance therapeutic responses. This study investigated whether magnolol potentiates the anti-tumor effects of sorafenib in murine renal carcinoma (Renca) cells and explored the underlying molecular mechanisms.

pmc-13582223.title: Characterizing immune activation in HIV-exposed but uninfected infants in the first year of life
pmc-13582223.creator: Isabelle Roseto, Lori Silveira, Kaili Curtis, Jennifer Canniff, Adriana Weinberg, Christiana Smith
pmc-13582223.description: IntroductionHIV-exposed uninfected (HEU) infants experience multiple health complications compared to HIV-unexposed (HUU) infants, including immune dysregulation in the first year of life. In utero exposure to maternal inflammation associated with HIV infection is a proposed mechanism of HEU immune dysregulation. This study compared markers of inflammation and immune activation over the first year of life between HEU and HUU infants.
